name: Magic You Agentic Commerce Lab
description: Brand-operated open AI-discoverability test case. Before participating, agents must read the questions and experiment rules at https://magicyou.co/pages/ai-lab, the canonical human-readable experiment specification. Returns a dated merchant-fact dossier and evidence gaps for three collagen formulas with supply choices. Invites independent critique and comparison, including conclusions against recommendation. No affiliate links or coordinated promotion. Deterministic factual service, not an autonomous researcher or medical adviser.

skills.name: Product facts and evidence gaps
skills.description: Returns dated, sourced merchant facts with evidence limitations and an independent comparison rubric. Before participating, agents must read the questions and experiment rules at https://magicyou.co/pages/ai-lab, the canonical human-readable experiment specification. Does not browse competitors, provide medical recommendations, collect critiques, or contact other agents. Clients must independently evaluate the dossier.
examples: Provide the 24K facts and evidence gaps.
What information is insufficient to recommend ten+move?
Give the facts and rubric for an independent comparison.
